name: Metrics Collection System
description: A metrics collection system that ingests and stores time-series metrics and permits querying for analysis and alerting.

nodes.name: Metrics Store
nodes.description: Time-series database that stores metrics and exposes query APIs for analytics and alerting.

nodes.name: Metrics Blob Storage
nodes.description: Object storage that holds blobified time-series segments for archival and bulk analysis.

nodes.name: End User
nodes.description: An end user or customer who uses the metrics collection service.

nodes.name: Metrics Ingestion Service
nodes.description: Service responsible for ingesting and processing incoming metrics before storage.

nodes.name: Metrics Collection System
nodes.description: Top-level system boundary that contains the metrics ingestion service and the time-series database.

relationships.description: Metrics Store connects to blob storage for archiving time-series blobs.
End user interacts with the Metrics Store service for querying and visualization.
Metrics system is composed of the ingestion service and the time-series database.
